name: pdf-merge-ai
description: PDF analysis, merge/split planning, and metadata extraction. By MEOK AI Labs.

tools.name: merge_info
tools.description: Plan a PDF merge operation. Provide file descriptions as JSON array of objects with 'name', 'pages' (optional), and 'size_kb' (optional) fields.

tools.name: split_info
tools.description: Plan a PDF split operation. Split spec examples: 'every 5' (5-page chunks), '1-3,4-8,9-12' (custom ranges), 'even' / 'odd' (page parity).

tools.name: get_metadata
tools.description: Extract or generate PDF metadata. Provide either base64-encoded first 1KB of PDF, or a JSON object with manual metadata fields.

tools.name: validate_pdf
tools.description: Validate PDF structure from base64-encoded header bytes. Checks version, structure, and encryption status.
